name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.indomaret.status.IndomaretStatusActivity
description: After a user starts Indomaret store payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen shows the payment result and the payment code as text and a barcode, plus store payment instructions.
disableEffect: Disabling it can hide the Indomaret store payments payment result or the instructions needed to complete it.
